target: Original complete fixed response plus EOS, same scalar log-probability target and same native model input for every variant.
reference: Original eligible-token EOS reference; no query rescaling, no grouping or target selection in the variants.

rules.DT_endpoint_symmetric: Half the forward signed vector minus half the vector from the same two complete endpoints in reverse order.
rules.DT_gate_symmetric: Symmetric normalized-content times SiLU gate product at every GDN layer; memory recurrence unchanged.
rules.DT_memory_symmetric: Average both endpoint orders of the local memory recurrence at every GDN layer; output gate unchanged.
rules.DT_gdn_symmetric: Both preceding GDN changes, uniformly at every GDN layer.

metrics: Original signed RISE and positive-part MAS; both tasks lack retrieval gold labels.
selection_rule: No selection in validation: candidate is already frozen. Report every task and paired metric.
validation: Fixed original benchmark indices, selected before these candidate results. Previously inspected benchmark; descriptive transfer check, not unseen holdout.
validation_success: Report every task and paired RISE/MAS difference using fresh native baselines. No candidate reselection. Historical drift is descriptive and is not counted as candidate improvement.

bootstrap.unit: Paired cases sampled within each of two tasks; equal task mean weighting. Descriptive intervals.

runtime_validation: Repeat original DT after the candidate on every example; repeat the candidate on the first example. Do not relax the existing 1e-4 vector consistency threshold.
integration: First case deployed factory versus frozen prototype must match bitwise. Every within-process baseline repeat retains relative L2 <1e-4. Same inputs as the fixed original transfer selection.
cost: First case: once both paths have run, one extra warm pair and five alternating timed pairs. Report full attribution diagnostic time and peak allocated memory; do not extrapolate to batched production.
baseline_policy: Fresh DT_original, DT_gdn_symmetric and FT_K1 in the same native process. Keep within-process repeat relative-L2 guard at 1e-4; deployed candidate must match the frozen prototype bitwise. Historical inputs must match, while historical root/vector differences are recorded as separate diagnostics.
amendment_reason: Two pre-metric archival checks failed with native root effects 73.5349377861096 and 72.6441776777192 versus historical 73.18754371536602, while each process was bitwise stable and the candidate matched its prototype. No attribution or scoring rule changed.
